headline: US Grants Six-Month Waiver for Global Russian Diesel Sales
summary: The US Treasury Department issued a six-month waiver allowing Russian diesel sales on global markets following discussions between US and Russian leadership. The policy aims to lower domestic fuel prices ahead of the upcoming US midterm elections.
why: Global refined oil supply balances significantly impact domestic fuel pricing, headline inflation, and energy market refining margins.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Additional diesel supply entering the market exerts downward pressure on global refined fuel and crude oil prices.

why_moved: Global energy futures responded to the expected influx of Russian refined petroleum products following the US Treasury waiver.
